Working together

Audit Process.

A structured security review process, from defining scope and assessing protocol risks to validating vulnerabilities, reviewing fixes, and delivering the final audit report.

01 / SCOPE

Understand the System

Collaborate with the protocol team to define the audit scope, review timelines, understand system architecture, and establish critical security assumptions.

02 / REVIEW

Security Assessment

Conduct an in-depth security review, examining protocol invariants, attack surfaces, and edge cases to identify exploitable vulnerabilities.

03 / VERIFY

Validate & Remediate

Discuss findings with the protocol team, validate their impact, and review implemented fixes to ensure identified vulnerabilities are properly addressed.

04 / REPORT

Final Audit Report

Deliver a comprehensive security report documenting findings, severity, technical evidence, remediation details, and final verification status.
